anchor.desc: bottom-centre of the 3x3 footprint: world (fx*16 + 24, (fy+3)*16), (fx,fy) = 0-based cell of ','; frame top-left = (fx*16, (fy+3)*16 - 76)

depth_sort_y: (fy+3)*16 (same as the fountain draw it replaces)

with_necklace.when: necklace still hidden on the statue ('$' item not taken)

with_necklace_glint.note: sparkle ~every 2 s; use instead of the static with_necklace

design: the KING (issue #1): broad-shouldered, full curled beard, tall crown, heavy robe with an ermine fur mantle, sceptre in his right hand, left arm across the robe; weathered limestone with cracks, chips, moss; necklace draped over the mantle in the Necklace item gold + ruby
backups: queen original: statue_queen_necklace.png, statue_queen_plain.png, statue_queen_necklace_glint.png, make_statue_queen.py
